Yeah, Earl Barnes was playing, uh, alto. And, uh, we had, uh, Joe Rainey on drums. And, uh, we had, uh, myself on bass. After I got off trumpet. Got on bass. And, uh, let me see who else we had. We had a trauma on clear. Yeah, we had, uh, oh, I'm trying to think now who we had on trauma on, in the time. We had a trauma on clear, but I can't think of who it was in time we had on trauma. You'll probably think in a minute when we come to you.
Mm-hmm. Anyway, uh, I was wondering about, uh, you mentioned hearing Bunk before we started. When, when, and where did you hear Bunk Johnson? Do you remember?
